text: Riya was a curious little girl.
She loved stories and asking questions.
Every morning, she watched children go to school.
She wished she could go too.
One day, Riya asked her mother a question.
Why can’t I go to school?
Her mother said school costs money.
Riya felt sad but hopeful.
A teacher named Miss Anaya visited the area.
Riya told her about her dream.
Miss Anaya listened carefully.
She smiled kindly.
Miss Anaya explained something important.
Children aged 6 to 14 have a right to education.
School must be free for them.
Education is a right, not a favor.
The next week, Riya went to school.
She wore a uniform and carried books.
Her smile was bright and confident.
Her dream came true.
